summary: 16-bit luminance-plus-alpha texture decompressor. Computes a source dword pointer from this+0x18 plus this+0x1050 (row) and this+0x1054 (slice) pitch products with the two index arguments, then loops over this+0x1058 texels. Each texel consumes two consecutive uint16 words: the current word drives RGB (all three output channels equal, scaled by 0.000015259022 ~ 2^-16) and the previously-consumed word drives the alpha channel with the same scale. Writes 4-float RGBA output. When the this+0x10 flag is non-zero, ContactManifoldCleanup is called on the decoded float output.

operations.description: Compute source dword pointer v4 = this+0x18 + a3 * this+0x1054 + a2 * this+0x1050 (slice and row pitch products with the index arguments).
For-loop iterating over this+0x1058 texels from v4 up to v4 + this+0x1058; each iteration consumes one dword (two uint16 words) and emits one 4-float RGBA texel.
v7 = (double)(unsigned __int16)*v4 * 0.000015259022; the current uint16 word is the luminance sample scaled to float.
Write RGB channels from the luminance sample: a4[2] = a4[1] = *a4 = v7, then advance the output pointer by 4 floats.

Set the alpha channel of the just-written texel (via the loop increment) to the previously-consumed uint16 word scaled by 0.000015259022. The scale factor corresponds to the two read-only globals flt_5AD290 and flt_5ADB14.
Guard: if this+0x10 is non-zero, post-process the decoded float output.
Call ContactManifoldCleanup((int)this, &a4[-4 * this+0x1058]) on the decoded float RGBA output buffer start.
